_styleGuide.philosophy: Warm, human, practical. We reject cold-blue AI clichés, stock photo aesthetics, and corporate sterility. Every image should feel like it belongs to a brand that is direct, confident, and a little unexpected.
doThis: Use warm tones — reds, ambers, warm teals against deep navy
Abstract geometric compositions with clear focal points
Layered flat shapes with subtle depth through overlapping planes
Generous negative space — let the composition breathe
Centered subject with breathing room for text overlay
Subtle dot/grid textures that echo the Superdot brand mark
Warm lighting that feels inviting, not clinical
neverDoThis: Robots, android faces, or sci-fi imagery
Cold blue AI aesthetics or matrix-style visuals
Busy, cluttered scenes with too many competing elements
Text, words, logos, or watermarks in the image
Clip art, cartoonish, or low-effort illustration
Generic tech imagery (random circuit boards, floating screens)

colorRationale.background: #0B1222 deep navy provides contrast and sophistication without going pure black
colorRationale.red: #E8363B is the primary brand accent — use for hero focal elements and energy
colorRationale.teal: #14B8A6 is the secondary accent — use for supporting elements and calm/analytical topics
colorRationale.amber: #F59E0B is the tertiary accent — use for warmth, highlights, and optimistic topics
colorRationale.gradients: Subtle dark-to-darker navy gradients. Never bright or neon gradients.

brandStyle.basePrompt: Warm, modern abstract illustration. Bold geometric shapes with layered depth. Deep navy background (#0B1222). Subtle dot-grid texture overlay across the composition. Warm radial glow from bottom-left edge — soft red (#E8363B at 12% opacity). Flat design with overlapping planes creating depth. Generous negative space. Centered composition with clear focal point. No text, no words, no letters, no logos. Human and approachable, not cold or clinical.
brandStyle.negativeElements: text, words, letters, logos, watermarks, signatures, photorealistic faces, stock photo style, clip art, cartoonish, busy, cluttered, low quality, robots, android, sci-fi, matrix, neon, cold blue, corporate sterile, circuit board cliché, handshake, hands shaking, clasped hands, human hands, greeting gesture, handshaking

engineering.promptHint: Clean code-editor-inspired shapes, structured grid patterns, terminal-like layered panels, teal accent glow against navy. Think architect's blueprint, not hacker movie.

marketing.promptHint: Upward-trending abstract shapes, bold red focal elements, dynamic diagonal compositions, growth and momentum. Warm and confident energy.

sales.promptHint: Warm amber highlights, abstract funnel and conversion arc shapes, ascending trajectory lines, flowing pipeline forms, golden light accents suggesting deals closing and targets reached. Dynamic forward momentum — opportunity in motion.

hr.promptHint: Abstract human silhouettes as simple geometric forms, interconnected network nodes, organizational tree patterns with teal accents. Warm and people-centered.

finance.promptHint: Abstract bar charts and ledger grids, currency-inspired geometric forms, amber accent lighting suggesting value and precision. Clean and orderly.

operations.promptHint: Interlocking shapes, smooth workflow arrows, process-flow inspired compositions with teal accents. Conveys systems working in harmony.

legal.promptHint: Abstract balance/scale motifs, layered document planes, section-symbol-inspired geometry with red accents. Structured and decisive.

customer-support.promptHint: Abstract speech-bubble shapes, radiating help-signal patterns, warm amber tones suggesting availability and responsiveness.

design.promptHint: Color-swatch abstractions, grid-and-layout compositions, design-tool-inspired shapes with bold red accents. Deliberate and refined.

strategy.promptHint: Abstract chess-piece or compass motifs, bird's-eye-view map compositions, red focal elements suggesting direction and leadership.

technology.promptHint: Abstract chip or node-network patterns, layered interface panels, teal data-flow accents. Modern and capable, never dystopian.

useCases.automation: Smooth flowing arrows, interlocking gear-like abstract shapes, conveyor-belt-inspired patterns suggesting effortless motion
useCases.analysis: Abstract data visualization shapes, bar-and-line chart motifs, magnifying-glass geometry suggesting insight and clarity
useCases.writing: Layered document planes, abstract pen-stroke flowing lines, text-block shapes arranged with editorial elegance
useCases.communication: Radiating signal waves, interconnected node clusters, abstract broadcasting patterns suggesting reach and connection
useCases.planning: Abstract calendar grids, roadmap-inspired horizontal lanes, milestone markers suggesting organized forward progress
useCases.integration: Puzzle-piece abstractions, bridge and connector motifs, converging paths suggesting unified systems
useCases.monitoring: Abstract dashboard panels, pulse-line patterns, radar-sweep motifs suggesting vigilance and awareness

promptTemplates._description: These templates show the full prompt structure. The generation script builds prompts by combining basePrompt + topic + department hints + use case hints + composition.
promptTemplates.heroImage: {basePrompt} Topic: {title}. Context: {description}. Department visual style: {department.promptHint}. Accent color: {department.accent}. Visual motifs: {useCase}. Aspect ratio 1200x630, widescreen banner composition. Centered focal point with breathing room.
promptTemplates.socialCard: {basePrompt} Topic: {title}. {department.promptHint}. Accent color: {department.accent}. Square composition 1200x1200. Bold central element. Extra negative space for social media text overlay.
promptTemplates.newsletterHeader: {basePrompt} Abstract warm geometric pattern. {department.promptHint}. Accent color: {department.accent}. Wide panoramic strip composition 1200x300. Subtle and atmospheric, designed as background texture.

qualityCalibration._description: Guidelines for evaluating generated images against brand standards.
goodSignals: Deep navy dominates with warm accent colors popping against it
Clear focal point — you instantly know what the image is about
Generous whitespace/negative space — the composition breathes
Geometric shapes feel intentional and layered, not randomly scattered
Warm undertones even in the dark areas
Could sit naturally on the blog next to the Space Grotesk headlines
Looks distinctive — you wouldn't confuse it with a generic tech blog
badSignals: Cold blue dominates — feels like every other AI company
Cluttered with too many small elements competing for attention
Photorealistic elements mixed with abstract (inconsistent style)
Text or letter-like artifacts in the image
Pure black background instead of deep navy (loses warmth)
Neon or overly saturated colors that clash with the brand palette
regenerateIf: Any visible text, letters, or logo-like artifacts
Cold blue is the dominant color instead of warm accents on navy
The image looks like a stock photo or clip art
No clear focal point — the eye wanders with nothing to anchor on
Robots, faces, or recognizable real-world objects that break the abstract style

socialStyles._description: Style variants for social images. The generate-social-image.mjs script rotates through these to avoid visual monotony. Agents can override with --style <name>.

bold-geometric.promptOverride: Ultra-bold single geometric shape, massive scale, fills 60% of frame. Deep navy background (#0B1222) with subtle dot-grid texture overlay. Soft warm red radial glow from bottom-left corner. One dominant brand color used as primary, not accent. Sharp edges, confident composition. Three small ascending dots near one corner as a subtle brand signature. Graphic design poster energy.

data-visual.promptOverride: Abstract data visualization: flowing chart lines, minimal bar shapes, insight-moment composition. Warm amber (#F59E0B) and red (#E8363B) accents on deep navy (#0B1222). Subtle dot-grid texture in the background. Soft warm glow emanating from data focal points. Clean, analytical aesthetic with warm undertones. Think dashboard art, not cold corporate charts.

scene-vignette.promptOverride: Dramatic silhouette vignette: single figure or object in stark contrast against deep navy (#0B1222). Dot-grid pattern faintly visible in the darker areas. Cinematic lighting with warm red radial glow (#E8363B) from bottom edge, deep shadows, warm accent backlight. Minimal, atmospheric, editorial photography feel rendered as abstract art.

textured-minimal.promptOverride: Minimal composition with rich texture: prominent dot-grid pattern echoing the Superdot brand mark, subtle noise, single floating geometric element. Warm red radial glow from bottom-left edge. Brand red (#E8363B) as sole accent on deep navy (#0B1222). Maximum negative space. Refined and confident.
